title: agentic-weight-editing: code, lab notebook and data for “Agentic Weight-Space Programming as an Alternative to Fine-Tuning in Small Language Models”

creators.name: Melo, Luiz Felipe
creators.affiliation: Universidade do Sul de Santa Catarina (Unisul)

description:
Code, dated lab notebook (pt-BR), experiment registry, result summaries, agent briefs and notes, and every weight edit submitted by the agents, for the pre-paper Agentic Weight-Space Programming as an Alternative to Fine-Tuning in Small Language Models. Claude agents repair thinking loops in Qwen3.5-0.8B with at most four rank-1 weight edits, compared against decoding baselines, thinking off, a scripted search and LoRA fine-tuning, on one consumer GPU.

Licenses: code under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); text, figures and data records under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0). Edits and edited weights derive from Qwen3.5-0.8B (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud). Problems quoted in data/ come from GSM8K and MATH (both MIT).
notes: Raw generations (~210 MB) and GGUF models are not included; see README.md. Claude (through Claude Code) wrote most of the code and kept the lab notebook under the author's supervision; see the paper's section 'Use of AI tools'.
